translations.web: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
translations.bsb: But as for you, go on your way until the end. You will rest, and then you will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days.”
translations.kjv: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
translations.asv: But go thou thy way till the end be; for thou shalt rest, and shalt stand in thy lot, at the end of the days.
